goal:
Both candidate_github_promoter and candidate_npm_promoter show queried=0 promoted=0 -- their queues are exhausted. Re-seed both with fresh discovery searches.

FIX 1 - candidate_github_promoter: The promoter is processing an empty queue because it only promotes existing candidates, not discovering new ones. Add an active discovery mode: every N cycles (or when queue is empty), search GitHub API for new MCP repos using these queries in rotation:
  - 'mcp server model-context-protocol' in:readme
  - 'topic:mcp-server'
  - 'modelcontextprotocol' in:name,description
  - '@modelcontextprotocol' in:readme language:typescript
  - 'fastmcp OR mcp-framework' in:readme
For each result: INSERT INTO mcp_discovery_candidates (candidate_name, candidate_url, discovered_in_directory='github_search', discovered_status='active', promoted=false) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
GitHub token from env: GITHUB_PAT.

FIX 2 - candidate_npm_promoter: When queue empty, search npm registry for new packages:
  - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=mcp+server&size=250
  - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=modelcontextprotocol&size=250
  - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=mcp-server&size=250
  - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=fastmcp&size=250
Insert new packages not already in candidates as discovered_in_directory='npm_search'.

Target: seed 2000+ fresh candidates across both sources within one cycle.
constraints: Rate limit GitHub API: max 30 req/min
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on all inserts
